**Finding submitted: `missing` (high severity, T4C).**

- **What's there:** Section 9 contains only cause-based exits (9.1 material breach, 9.2 insolvency, 9.3 security/SLA/law/IP), with numbering skipping straight to 9.5. Section 8.1 sets a three-year term, and Section 2.1 layers a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights."
- **Gap:** No Customer termination for convenience in a multi-year term — the playbook walk-away scenario. Vendor has no convenience right either, which is favourable to us, so we lock that in rather than disturb it.
- **Redline (validated `ok:true`):** New Section 9.4 inserted after 9.3 — Customer convenience termination of the Agreement or any Order Form, in whole or in part, on 30 days' notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, no penalty or accelerated Fees, expressly overriding Section 2.1; plus confirmation that Vendor has no convenience right during a term. The comment offers the 60–90 day / three-month-fee-cap fallback.
